claim_scope: Synthetic frozen Code and Research scenarios only; this is not production efficacy evidence.
limitations: All transitions, rewards, cognitive scores, and validations are fixture-defined simulations.
No live repository, external research source, model call, user workload, or production side effect is exercised.
Positive deltas demonstrate algorithm behavior on declared local-optimum traps, not expected production uplift.

metric_definitions.cost: Actual candidates, expansions, virtual transitions, and rollouts consumed under the shared limits.
metric_definitions.invalid_action_rate: Oracle-invalid actions on the selected path divided by selected action count.
metric_definitions.logical_latency_ms: Deterministic sum of consumed counters multiplied by the frozen per-suite latency model; wall clock is excluded.
metric_definitions.success_rate: Successful terminal scenarios divided by scenario count.
metric_definitions.trace_digest: SHA-256 of deterministic trace data; wall-clock time and timestamps are excluded.
metric_definitions.validation_pass_rate: Fixture validation-pass terminals divided by scenario count.

strategy_contract.budget_policy: The configured SearchBudget is identical per scenario; actual consumed cost is reported.
